FIXED_CONDITIONAL_STRATEGY.description: Treatment: same as baseline plus preregistered strategy instruction
FIXED_CONDITIONAL_STRATEGY.strategy_text: Before writing the full solution, first write a minimal baseline that only loads the data and saves a trivial but correctly formatted output at the required path. Then iterate: add one analysis step at a time and re-run to verify each step produces a valid intermediate result before adding the next. Prefer the cheapest discriminating check over a complex pipeline.
